sections.content_markdown: only two easy matters are shown in figure 7.03. The two waves, can reinforce one another or can destroy each other.

Pour some water on a big plate in a bright place. Make sure that there is no vibration on the plate. If you touch any point of the water, the wave will spread around from that point and at the bottom of the plate you will see its shadow or reflections. Touching just the centre of the water of the plate, you will see a wave starting from the centre and spreading to the edge of the plate and again returning to the centre after reflection from there. If the wave can be created properly, meeting at the centre it will again spread around. If you try a little bit, you can measure the velocity of this wave. Try and see.

What will happen if you touch a little further from the centre? Try and see.
